title: Khoon Ka Karz
desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?

title: Tulsi
desc: Tulsi and Manieri are twin sisters. Ganesh Singh, an army man, falls in love with Tulsi with her father refuses to give him Tulsi as he hails from a low class. Moorat Singh and Manthra are busy bodies of the village, arrange for her marriage with a greedy Thakur.

title: Guddu
desc: Guddu and Salina meet with an accident and she loses her eyesight. Later, when Guddu learns that he is terminally ill, he decides to donate his eyes to her, but his father disapproves.

title: Nishchaiy
desc: When Ravi is falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to jail, his boss's wife, Renuka, promises to take care of his younger brother. However, Ravi is unable to find his brother after he is released.
